claims.quote: His title is his humanity. The basis of his claim is the fact that he is a man.
claims.description: All citizens receive an identical income/credit regardless of work output, based solely on being human.

claims.quote: we have no money to pay wages in, but, as I said, we have nothing at all answering to your idea of wages.
claims.description: A moneyless economy with no wages, where citizens draw on a state credit allotment.

claims.quote: We require, indeed, by law that every man shall serve the nation for a fixed period
claims.description: Universal compulsory national labor service for all citizens organized as an industrial army.

claims.quote: The fact that the nation is the sole capitalist and land-owner of course restricts the individual's possessions to his annual credit
claims.description: The state owns all capital and land; individuals hold only annual credits and personal goods.

claims.quote: With us, diligence in the national service is the sole and certain way to public repute, social distinction, and official power.
claims.description: Honor, rank and political power are awarded based on quality of service in the national industrial army instead of wages motivating effort.

claims.quote: we have abolished poverty and the fear of it, and inordinate luxury with the hope of it
claims.description: Poverty and extreme luxury are abolished through equal national credit.

claims.quote: there was one of these great distributing establishments in each ward of the city, so that no residence was more than five or ten minutes' walk from one of them.
claims.description: Retail replaced by public sample stores in each ward with identical assortments, no advertising and no sales pressure.

claims.quote: The orders are sent to the warehouse, and the goods distributed from there.
claims.description: Orders are taken from samples and goods are shipped from a central warehouse directly to producers' customers, eliminating retailers and middlemen.

claims.quote: The dispatching clerk has a dozen pneumatic transmitters before him answering to the general classes of goods, each communicating with the corresponding department at the warehouse.
claims.description: Pneumatic tube networks transmit orders to warehouses within a city and distribute goods to homes.

claims.quote: The packages are then delivered by larger tubes to the city districts, and thence distributed to the houses.
claims.description: Goods are delivered to homes via large pneumatic tubes.

claims.quote: Bales of cloth are placed on spindles and turned by machinery, and the cutter, who also has a machine, works right through one bale after another till exhausted
claims.description: Mechanized warehouse order-filling with machine cutting of cloth.

claims.quote: These printed cards, for which the government authorities are responsible, give us all the information we can possibly need.
claims.description: Government-certified product information cards replace salesclerks' advice, eliminating deceptive selling.

claims.quote: the clerk had punched the value of her purchase out of the credit card she gave him
claims.description: A credit card that is debited by punching out the purchase value, used in place of money.

claims.quote: These halls are connected by telephone with all the houses of the city whose people care to pay the small fee
claims.description: A telephone-based subscription service piping live professional music from concert halls to homes, on demand, around the clock.

claims.quote: any one of the four pieces now going on that you prefer, you can hear by merely pressing the button which will connect your house-wire with the hall where it is being rendered.
claims.description: Selecting among simultaneous live concert channels by pressing a button, like channel selection.

claims.quote: All our bedchambers have a telephone attachment at the head of the bed by which any person who may be sleepless can command music at pleasure
claims.description: Bedside telephone receivers provide music on demand at any hour.

claims.quote: the volume of melody had been perfectly graduated to the size of the apartment.
claims.description: Music volume is automatically/adjustably matched to room size via simple controls.

claims.quote: All the really fine singers and players are in the musical service, and the rest of us hold our peace for the main part.
claims.description: Professional musicians serve in a state music service while amateurs rarely perform, since piped music is superior.

claims.quote: The rents which the nation receives for these houses vary, according to size, elegance, and location, so that everybody can find something to suit.
claims.description: Housing owned by the nation and rented at varying rates paid from equal incomes.

claims.quote: The nation takes charge of the resigned chattels, and turns such as are of value into the common stock once more.
claims.description: Excess inherited goods are voluntarily renounced and returned to the national common stock, so inheritance limits itself without law.

claims.quote: Now that industry of whatever sort is no longer self-service, but service of the nation, patriotism, passion for humanity, impel the worker as in your day they did the soldier.
claims.description: Without profit motive, patriotism and honor will motivate workers as efficiently as the profit motive did.

claims.quote: Under our system of handling the goods, persuading the customer to buy them, cutting them off, and packing them, ten clerks would not do what one does here. The saving must be enormous.
claims.description: Eliminating retailers and sales competition yields vast labor savings in distribution.
